fact_checks.detail: no site-specific development control plan is recorded for the site - consent must not be granted (8.4)

fact_checks.name: design review panel trigger
fact_checks.detail: the trigger engages (a building height 13.5 m > 12 m and 4 storeys > 3 storeys is higher than the threshold) - design review panel review is a precondition of consent

fact_checks.name: minimum site area
fact_checks.detail: site area 1150 m2 < required 1400 m2 (Site G, Zone R3, residential flat building)

fact_checks.detail: site frontage 32 m >= required 30 m (Site G, Zone R3, residential flat building)

findings.reasoning: The proposed use, 'Residential flat building', is listed in the 'with development consent' column of the LUT-R3 for the R3 zone.

findings.quote: The height of a building on any land is not to exceed the maximum height shown for the land on the Height of Buildings Map.
findings.reasoning: This clause refers to the Height of Buildings Map, which is not provided. Therefore, a determination regarding height compliance cannot be made.

findings.quote: The maximum floor space ratio for a building on any land is not to exceed the floor space ratio shown for the land on the Floor Space Ratio Map.
findings.reasoning: This clause refers to the Floor Space Ratio Map, which is not provided. Therefore, a determination regarding FSR compliance cannot be made.

findings.quote: Development consent may, subject to this clause, be granted for development even though the development would contravene a development standard imposed by this or any other environmental planning instrument.
findings.reasoning: This clause deals with exceptions to development standards, but is only relevant if a contravention is identified. It does not independently trigger a refusal or requirement.

findings.quote: In this Part—Frenchs Forest Precinct means the land identified on the Precincts Map as the Frenchs Forest Precinct.
findings.reasoning: This clause provides definitions and does not contain any development control requirements.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development on land in the Frenchs Forest Precinct unless a development control plan has been prepared for the land that provides for the following—
findings.reasoning: The case record states that no site-specific DCP has been prepared for the site, and the site is within the Frenchs Forest Precinct. Therefore, consent must not be granted.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted unless the consent authority considers that the development exhibits design excellence.
findings.reasoning: This clause applies to design excellence on Sites F, G and I. This application is on Site G, but design excellence is a judgement for the consent authority, not a determination based on objective criteria.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development in relation to a building that is, or will, be higher than 12 metres or 3 storeys, or both, unless—(a) a design review panel has reviewed the development, and (b) the consent authority considers the findings of the panel.
findings.reasoning: The proposed building is 13.5m high (greater than 12m) and 4 storeys (greater than 3 storeys), triggering the requirement for review by a design review panel.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development in a site and zone shown in Columns 1 and 2 of the following table, for a purpose shown in Column 3, unless the site area is equal to or greater than the area shown in Column 4—
findings.reasoning: The site area is 1150 sqm, while the minimum site area for a residential flat building on Site G in the R3 zone is 1400 sqm. Therefore, the proposal contravenes this clause.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development in a site and zone shown in Columns 1 and 2 of the following table, for a purpose shown in Column 3, unless the street frontage of the site area is equal to or greater than the length shown in Column 4—
findings.reasoning: The site frontage is 32m, which meets the minimum requirement of 30m for a residential flat building on Site G in the R3 zone.

findings.quote: Development consent must not be granted to development on Site F unless the consent authority is satisfied the development will not result in less than 5,500 square metres of deep soil zone in Site F.
findings.reasoning: This clause applies only to Site F, and the application is for Site G.

findings.quote: This clause applies to the following development—(a) development that is or involves the relocation of the Frenchs Forest Police Station to Site F,
findings.reasoning: This clause relates to the relocation of the Frenchs Forest Police Station to Site F and is not relevant to this application.

overall.summary: The development application is refused due to two key contraventions of the Warringah LEP 2011. Firstly, the site lacks a site-specific DCP as required by clause 8.4 for development within the Frenchs Forest Precinct. Secondly, the site area is less than the minimum required by clause 8.6 for a residential flat building on Site G. While design review is triggered by clause 8.5(4), the application fails on other grounds.
